--- docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
+++ docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
@@ -139,6 +139,8 @@
 
 This is bounded local capture recovery, not completeness: process death before acknowledged capture, legacy/old-consumer retries, DLQ/quarantine, SDK logical-event collisions, late-hour fold repair, exceptional object fragmentation and deployed performance remain open. Fresh barrier checks are not an atomic global erasure fence; pre-cutoff races, ETag ABA, concurrent journal coordination and manifest omissions remain limitations. Claim lifecycle/retention and operational activation require their respective approvals; the flag is default-off and no deployment is implied.
 
+The consumer validates each complete ledger envelope before grouped persistence; an invalid row rejects its whole envelope without blocking valid siblings. Unversioned and `version:1` legacy messages without a delivery ID remain supported. Other explicit versions, malformed/empty sets, invalid explicit delivery IDs and caller-supplied reserved provenance are rejected, never partially filtered. Its ordered per-envelope `ack`/`retry` dispositions control queue acknowledgement; missing dispositions retry. `ok` is false if any envelope retries, and `skipped` counts rejected envelopes, not acknowledged drops or individual rows. Successful erasure suppression can acknowledge. Shared storage/barrier/capture failure retries the admitted cohort because aggregate partial counts do not prove individual completion. This does not add quarantine/DLQ or prevent retry exhaustion; legacy partial writes can still duplicate. A completely removed managed ID is indistinguishable from legitimate legacy input. Fan-out/statistics and producer activation are unchanged.
+
 ## 3. Identity
 
 All under `/v1/{tenant}/identity/`. The first two take the site key; the rest take the operator token.
